query.sql:
SELECT
  scope.passages AS passages,
  scope.paragraphs AS paragraphs,
  scope.questions AS questions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision.disposition = 'quarantine') AS quarantined,
  expertReview.answerAgreement.matches AS expertMatches,
  expertReview.answerAgreement.total AS expertTotal,
  expertReview.materialAmbiguityCount AS materialAmbiguities
FROM read_json_auto('output/audits/ielts-reading-rights-matching-information-2026-08-09/validation.json') AS report,
UNNEST(report.decisions) AS rows(decision)
GROUP BY ALL;

SELECT
  decision.assetId,
  decision.title,
  decision.wordCount,
  decision.questionCount,
  decision.provenanceStatus,
  decision.rightsBasis,
  decision.factualReviewStatus,
  decision.humanReviewStatus,
  decision.disposition,
  array_to_string(decision.reasonCodes, ' · ') AS blockers
FROM read_json_auto('output/audits/ielts-reading-rights-matching-information-2026-08-09/validation.json') AS report,
UNNEST(report.decisions) AS rows(decision);

blocks.body: # IELTS Reading Matching Information — audit gate

## Executive Summary

- The F0.2b.4 control passes; the 3 passages do not. All remain quarantined.
- Independent review covered 18/18 statements, matched all stored paragraph mappings and found 0 material ambiguities.
- Predicting A–E for question positions 1–5 succeeds on 11/15 eligible items; content certification remains blocked.
- UI/UX and Playwright are outside this audit slice because all four learner-facing hashes are unchanged.

## The dossier passes; the bank is blocked

Hashes pin identity, incomplete rights records fail closed, and candidate evidence remains separate from verification. Matching every stored mapping is not enough: the bank exposes a strong position shortcut, most factual claims are oversimplified or untraceable, and no author, license, human factual review or human approval is recorded.

## Exact evidence and paragraph competition are explicit contracts

Each statement must resolve to one paragraph through an exact supporting span and a defensible paraphrase. The reviewer must also identify the closest competing paragraph and explain why it fails. Paragraph reuse is allowed only because every scoped instruction explicitly permits it.

## Paragraph-letter counts alone do not certify balance

The stored mappings are A 3, B 5, C 3, D 4 and E 3. The position-based A–E rule applies to 15 statements and succeeds on 11 (73%). Sequence, length, lexical overlap, titles and paragraph competition are audited separately.

## Plausible wording is not source verification

The direct-source pass found three of 15 declared claims supported as written; five were oversimplified and seven untraceable. Candidate institutional sources can contextualize a claim without proving the passage, its authorship or its license.

## The content still exposes useful learning targets

The clean walkthrough traces scanning cues, paraphrase checks, exact evidence and competitor rejection across all 18 statements. Its value is prospective and diagnostic: it assigns no paragraph mappings or bands and does not represent a real learner study.

## Panel scope

Applicable lanes pass only for a complete, conservative and reproducible dossier. UI/UX and Playwright are not applicable to this unchanged learner-facing delta; that is not approval of the existing interface.

## Recommended next decisions

1. Redesign question order and independently re-adjudicate it until the A–E position shortcut no longer predicts mappings.
2. Reduce direct lexical overlap and remeasure all paragraph-selection heuristics.
3. Resolve authorship, rights, exact factual support and independent human review for all three passages.
4. Keep F0.2b open; begin F0.2b.5 Matching Headings only in the next loop iteration.

## Caveats and open questions

The provenance search is directed and non-exhaustive. Source reachability is not verification. Both independent reviews are AI simulations without human signatures. The 18-question sample cannot certify statistical fairness. Runtime quarantine enforcement and learner-facing UI remain separate open units.

audit.scope: Three Matching Information assets, directed provenance search and ten-source availability ledger.
audit.findings: 3/3 assets remain unknown-quarantined; no exact public-web match was located in the directed non-exhaustive search.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: Authorship, license, rights-holder authorization, human factual review and human approval remain unresolved.

audit.scope: Three passages, 15 paragraphs, 18 statement mappings, registry identity, deny-by-default assessment and report binding.
audit.findings: 3 passages and 18 statement mappings are pinned by exact object/passage hashes; every record fails closed without structural contract errors.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: Runtime enforcement and content certification remain open; this PASS covers the dossier and detection controls only.

audit.scope: Independent two-pass review of all specific-information mappings and 15 declared factual claims.
audit.findings: 18/18 statements match the stored paragraph letters; 0 material ambiguities; all three passages have mixed IELTS fitness because they are short and unusually explicit.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: The bank still requires harder rewrites, independent re-adjudication and human editorial approval before content certification.

audit.scope: Blind content-only simulation from the perspective of an average learner.
audit.findings: 3/3 passages and 18/18 statements have explicit likely-misread, evidence-hunt, paraphrase, distractor, decision and repair observations.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: This is not a real-student usability, retention, transfer or accessibility study.

audit.scope: Paragraph-letter distribution, positional cycle, sequence, lexical overlap, statement length, per-set reuse, blind leakage and EN/ES mutation controls.
audit.findings: Stored letters are A=3, B=5, C=3, D=4, E=3; the A→E positional shortcut hits 11/15 eligible questions and both blind packets remain key-free.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: contentCertification remains blocked: n=18 is below the 100-decision gate and the positional shortcut is materially exploitable.

audit.scope: Not applicable to this audit-only delta; four learner-facing sources remain pinned to baseline hashes.
audit.findings: No route, component, catalog bank or learner interaction was changed by F0.2b.4.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: This does not certify the existing UI, accessibility, responsive behavior or Task 2 visual parity.

audit.scope: Not applicable to this audit-only delta; no learner-facing DOM or runtime behavior changed.
audit.findings: Static import scans and exact hashes establish the narrow N/A boundary.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: No browser matrix was executed for product conformance; portable-report Chromium QA is separate from learner UI testing.
